scope: Full video-stream decode of six 120-frame examples plus the 840-frame showreel; ordered visual inspection of critical sampled frames.

visual_findings.barrel_roll: Complete roll visible across phase samples, frame corners covered, geometry remains rigid.
visual_findings.whip_pan: Directionally blurred outgoing and incoming views bridge the transition; stable readable landing.
visual_findings.layered_vertigo: Foreground museum silhouette intact in the final frame; background scale change is clear; 2.5D label visible.
visual_findings.occlusion_wipe: Observed tracked pillar side-face and replacement boundary align at sampled frames 54–86.
visual_findings.match_zoom: Fast zoom/blur covers the day-night cut; no obvious clipped full-frame flash or empty edge.
visual_findings.speed_ramp: Train, track, trees and waterfall remain readable through the chosen sequence.
visual_findings.labels: Technique names, numbering and subtitles complete in reviewed frames.

intentional_static_frames: Layered-vertigo first eased interval and the showreel end card are intentional near-static content.
presentation: Strong enough for a first GitHub showcase; complete roll and real-pillar reveal provide immediate visual identity.
